# RuleId: # Actionable security controls remain WARN/FAIL by default. INFO preserves verified observations without hiding them.

Reason: Intentional cache policy is route-specific; private/dynamic HTML remains non-storable.
Only explicitly public SSR pages are cached; authenticated and dynamic content remains non-storable.
Bundled Base64 is permitted only after the compiled client passes the post-build secret scan.
FitVibe is a modern web application; CI also runs the ZAP Client Spider for browser-driven discovery.
Authentication request detection is expected and retained as evidence for future authenticated DAST.
Fetch Metadata headers originate from real browsers; traditional-spider requests may not contain them.
